## Purpose

This document tracks incidents where a Proxmox cluster node entered a fencing loop — being repeatedly fenced by the HA Manager within a short window. Each entry links back to the [runbook explanation](../runbook-explanation/ha_fencing_loop.qmd) and the [remediation runbook](../../runbooks/compute/ha_fencing_loop.md).

---

## Incident Log

### INC-002 — 2025-05-20

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Node** | pve-node-03 |
| **Fence events in window** | 5 (detected within 47 minutes) |
| **Root cause** | IPMI BMC unreachable from fence agent due to management VLAN misconfiguration after a switch firmware upgrade |
| **Impact** | 8 VMs migrated repeatedly across pve-node-01 and pve-node-02; two VMs experienced application-layer errors due to rapid successive restarts |
| **Resolved by** | Node isolated via maintenance mode; VLAN ACL corrected; node re-added after BMC reachability confirmed |
| **Resolution time** | 1 hour 12 minutes |
| **Runbook followed** | Yes — `ha_fencing_loop.md` |
| **Safety check passed** | Yes — `detect_ha_fencing_loop` confirmed loop before intervention; quorum verified intact (2 of 3 nodes) |

**Timeline:**

- `03:41` — Switch firmware upgrade completes on mgmt switch; management VLAN ACL silently drops IPMI traffic
- `03:44` — HA Manager loses heartbeat on pve-node-03; issues first fence via IPMI
- `03:44` — Fence "succeeds" (IPMI unreachable → agent times out with success assumption); node reboots unassisted
- `03:49` — pve-node-03 rejoins cluster; heartbeat re-established briefly
- `03:51` — Heartbeat lost again (node NIC negotiation delay post-boot); second fence issued
- `04:11` — On-call SRE paged: 4 fence events in 30 minutes
- `04:18` — `detect_ha_fencing_loop` confirms loop; quorum verified at 2/3
- `04:22` — pve-node-03 placed in maintenance mode; fencing stops
- `04:38` — Management VLAN ACL corrected; IPMI reachability verified from fence agent
- `04:53` — pve-node-03 removed from maintenance; HA resources re-enabled; cluster stable

**Notes:**
> The fence agent was configured to treat IPMI timeout as a successful fence (default Proxmox behaviour). This is intentional — an unreachable BMC is assumed to mean the node is powered off. The real fix is ensuring BMC reachability before production changes to the management network. A pre-change checklist item has been added.

## Recurring Patterns

- All recorded loop events have involved `pve-node-03` — its BMC is on a separate management VLAN that has been involved in two separate network changes
- Loop duration before detection: average 27 minutes — detection alerting threshold to be reduced to 10 minutes (2 fence events)
- No data corruption observed in any incident; RBD journals recovered cleanly in all cases

## Preventive Measures Tracked

| Measure | Status |
|---|---|
| Alert on ≥ 2 fence events within 15 minutes | 🔄 In progress — monitoring team |
| Add IPMI reachability to pre-change checklist for mgmt network | ✅ Done |
| Increase fence agent timeout to outlast node POST time | ✅ Done — set to 120 s |
| Redundant BMC network path (dedicated OOB switch) | ❌ Pending — hardware procurement |
| Automated `detect_ha_fencing_loop` check in CI chaos suite | 🔄 In progress |
